references.text: This verse describes how the goat-hair curtains were to be folded, and verse 9 provides context on how the sixth curtain was to be doubled in front of the tabernacle.
Verse 13 continues the description of how the excess fabric was to hang down on the sides of the tabernacle, as a direct continuation of verse 12.
This passage describes the actual execution of the instructions given in chapter 26, including the handling of the excess fabric on the back side of the tabernacle.
God gave Moses instructions to build the tabernacle exactly according to the pattern shown to him on the mountain, which underscores the importance of the detailed measurements in Exodus 26:12.
The planks in Exodus 26:23 form the structural back wall that the excess curtain in Exodus 26:12 is designed to cover.
The planks at the back (Exodus 26:22) form the structure that the excess curtain (Exodus 26:12) covers.
The crossbars (Exodus 26:27) provide structural support for the back side that the excess curtain (Exodus 26:12) covers.
